response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Norwegian Cruise reservation +1-866-254-7549 or  +44-120-420-8151 (AUS), you must call Norwegian Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly +1-866-254-7549 or +44-120-420-8151 (AUS), as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add someone to Norwegian Cruise online +1-866-254-7549 or +44-120-420-8151 (AUS), so you must contact Norwegian customer service or your travel agent directly by phone +1-866-254-7549 or +44-120-420-8151 (AUS). To add a guest to an existing Norwegian Cruise booking +1-866-254-7549 or +44-120-420-8151 (AUS), you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.
